## 5. Validation "}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"And Acceptance\n\nAcceptance requires synchronized ledgers, ready or explicitly excluded topics, audited topic plans, resolved invalida"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"tions, final integration, final audit, source lineage, captured testing requirements, current project context, zero unapproved incomple"}

{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"te content, a durable ApprovedPlanPack, and a passing approval CAS/currentness check before Plan Compile authority exists.


## 6. P"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"lan-To-Node Readiness\n\nPlanning Wizard can approve a pack for Plan Compile but does not itself create runtime WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, e"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"xecutable queues, implementation files, final node manifests, or production build tasks. End-to-end pipeline implementation readiness r"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"emains unproven until the clean-room fixture suite passes.\n\nThe final-review Approve And Build control consumes `Plans/.implementatio"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"n_readiness/buildability_gate_report.json` as a product gate. Captured source, plan-complete documentation, green validators, and seman"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"tic closure are preconditions only; they do not enable Approve And Build unless `buildability_gate_passed=true`. While blocked, the dis"}

{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"abled reason lists every open blocker family and its exact owner docs, and `PNC-019` surfaces as a hard disabled reason.
